instruction.name: vavgr.d
instruction.description: Compute the average (rounded towards positive infinity) of corresponding signed 64-bit elements in `a` and `b`, save the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vavgr.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vavgr.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vavgr.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vavgr.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vavgr.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vavgr.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vavgr.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vavgr.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
